race.comment: WICKED LEGEND (10) looks close to a win after pacing in his last two outings here, one over this distance when he came from this row to go under by 3.6m. He could break through with even luck. SUPERIOR ART (5) was solid when fifth from the back row last start. Recorded a win from this barrier along with a second in his previous two outings at this circuit and distance. Major player. NASHVILLE BART (9) may need some luck from this draw but is on the radar having placed here two back before finishing only 3.6m off the winner at Newcastle last time. HEY DUDE (4) draws a little wider but there was merit in the latest performance when fourth at this venue.
